data.title: Registration confirmation and course fee invoice (Anmeldung Gitarrenkurs für Erwachsene)
data.summary: Musikakademie Beispielton confirms the registration of Bastian Musterquell for an adult guitar course (twelve evenings) starting 14 January 2027 and asks for the course fee of €216.00. The letter gives two different payment dates for the same fee: "bis 09.12.2026" in the text and "fällig am 18.12.2026" in the payment box.
data.explanation: This is a registration confirmation from a music academy combined with a request to pay the course fee of €216.00 so your place in the course is secured. The letter contains two different dates for this one payment (9 December and 18 December 2026) — to be safe, transfer the amount by the earlier date and consider contacting the academy to confirm which date is correct. If you do not pay in time, your spot may not be guaranteed. No legal remedy is needed here; this is a private course booking, not an authority decision.
